semiconductor_relevance: High — the company provides specialized equipment and systems for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: AI SHENG KE (Jiangsu) Chemical Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in providing ultra-high purity electronic materials and equipment for semiconductor manufacturing. Their offerings include laboratory pilot systems, semiconductor material purification systems, and high-purity core equipment, catering to the needs of semiconductor material manufacturers.
capabilities: Laboratory pilot and intermediate pilot R&D systems
High-purity core equipment and pressure vessels
